verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's provider docs confirm it 'can use many LLM providers' and let you 'set the default model as provider/model' (openclaw-docs-26/87/102), and multi-agent isolation (each agent has its own workspace/state) suggests per-agent configuration is possible (openclaw-docs-25/76/99). However, the evidence never explicitly names Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or OpenRouter as supported providers, nor documents per-conversation model switching (only per-agent/default model setting), and one community thread notes Anthropic restricting use of 'claude -p' as a backend, hinting at friction with at least one provider integration. Missing for 10: explicit list of named providers (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/OpenRouter), documented UI/CLI flow for switching models mid-conversation, and independent confirmation that multi-provider switching works in practice.
